author: (Er. Marcus, 1958)

note.en: A translucent aeolid of about 4 mm, usually found on hydroids or seaweed in very shallow water, known here from one specimen taken at 8 m off the Manzanillo landing in 1999.
note.es: Un nudibranquio eólido translúcido de unos 4 mm, que suele vivir sobre hidroides o algas en aguas muy someras, conocido aquí por un ejemplar tomado a 8 m frente al muelle de Manzanillo en 1999.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1999)
Wikipedia lists Costa Rica and Panama in its range

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
